svg.title: Inspector: a floating sheet for the p99 latency point on the board checkout overview, with pivots and staged actions
svg.desc: Mockup 41 (T25, #164). Dark theme, 1440 by 900. The board checkout overview with the Inspector open on fixture P: the p99 latency panel, the series job shop/checkout, quantile 0.99, clicked at 13:41:20, value 2.84 s. The origin panel has a 2 px focus outline at a 2 px offset. The selected series is drawn last over a focus underlay and the other two series are dimmed to 0.35 alpha. The Inspector floats over the right of the content column, inset 12 px, 360 px wide, as a translucent surface-float sheet with a background blur, a 1 px hairline, one shadow and a 10 px radius. Its sections in order: header with the title p99 latency, the time 13:41:20.000 and the collapse and close buttons; the value 2.84 s with a copy button; details with Raw 2.84 and the time in UTC; labels job shop/checkout and quantile 0.99; pivots with two enabled chips, Explore and Logs plus or minus 1 min, each with its Context line, and four disabled dashed chips, Traces, Profiles, Entity and Label filter, with their reasons in visible text; the query histogram_quantile(0.99, x) in PromQL with edit and copy; and the actions Pin, Create alert and Ask AI, disabled with their M-UI4 reasons. Callouts: 1 material, 2 disclosed pivots, 3 the Esc ladder, 4 collapse.
